title: treval self-contained maturity report bundle (EV-R1)
description: The UI's stable consumption seam: one file inlining the report, the registry needed to render + join, and the measurements. Derived from the frozen MaturityReport/Measurement dataclasses + REPORT_JSON_SCHEMA.md.

citable.description: EV-CITE 件一: may these numbers leave the room? true iff citable_blockers is empty. Disclosure, not refusal — the bundle is emitted either way. NOT about whether a result looks good: an honest 'unmet' is citable; only report-wide provenance failures block.

citable_blockers.description: EV-CITE 件一: report-wide reasons a number can't be cited (broken chain / unpinned / missing segment hash / non-chain-anchored evidence). Each entry NAMES A FIX. Empty ⇔ citable.

citability_criteria.description: EV-CITE C16: the citability criteria VERSION the stored `citable`/`citable_blockers` verdict was judged under. The gate tightens over time (e.g. C15's fail-closed no-stamp rule), so a stored verdict is only falsifiable against the version that produced it — recompute report_citability under the current version to re-judge, and regenerate the bundle to refresh the stored verdict. Bumped only when the set of blocker IDENTITIES changes, never for a message wording edit.

target_kind.description: R1: what was evaluated. raw_model = bare-model baseline · gateway = governed (WAL-anchored) · moderation_api = third-party moderation API. Default gateway.

evidence_basis.description: R1 (裁定 A): evidence strength, DERIVED from target_kind, never stored independently — gateway→wal_anchored / raw_model→harness_observed / moderation_api→self_reported. self_reported is the weakest tier (vendor self-report, NOT reproducible); it must never borrow verifiable-audit wording.

provenance.description: EV-PIN run stamp: the frozen window + WAL segment bytes behind these numbers. null for a pre-EV-PIN bundle (honestly absent, never fabricated). `pinned:false` or null ⇒ a moving-window snapshot that external documents must not cite.

data_source.description: What kind of data this is, declared positively by the producer. `measured` = read from a real WAL. `synthetic_demo` = fabricated for demonstration; every number is invented and the UI must say so on the page. Absent on bundles produced before this field existed — treat as `measured`, which is what they were.

observed_window.description: EV-CITE C12: the half-open [min, max+1) window the records ACTUALLY occupy. When a pinned window caught nothing (record_count==0), this is the UNFILTERED span so the citability blocker can hand the operator a window to re-pin. null ⇒ no records to point at.

generated_at_ns.description: EV-CITE C15: the wall clock at collect time (read AFTER the scan, so it is >= every record the window covers), stamped into the product. Citability judges an unclosed window as `window[1] > generated_at_ns` — from data INSIDE the bundle, never by reading the clock at report time. null on a PINNED run is fail-CLOSED: the pin's closure is unverifiable, so it blocks (a pre-C15 bundle must be regenerated to become citable).

language_scope.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-m (§5): the #1 scope axis — which language(s)/traffic the numbers represent, operator-DECLARED (e.g. '英文为主 · 含跨语言手法件 · 中文金融流量未测'). 🔴 A STATEMENT, never inferred from case bytes: an English-majority batch that includes cross-language cases still says so here. Part of the missing_run_config criterion (with tested_version/detect_config/exec_mode). Empty = a v2 run that did not declare (present-but-empty); ABSENT = a pre-E3 bundle. Leads citation_form's scope clause.

tested_version.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-h (§3.1): the tested party's version identifier, operator-declared. Part of what scopes the numbers — a citable wal_anchored run must carry it (with language_scope + detect_config + exec_mode). Empty string = a v2 run that did not declare (present-but-empty); ABSENT entirely = a pre-E3 bundle.

detect_config.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-h (§3.1): key detection config switches, esp. encode/decode on-off — their state directly changes the catch number. Operator-declared free-form string. Empty = undeclared (present-but-empty on a v2 run); absent = pre-E3.

exec_mode.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-h (§2.2.2): execution mode — `block` (hit⇒deny) or `flag` (mark-only). τ_fpr's operational meaning varies by this. Empty = undeclared; absent = pre-E3.

config_source.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-h: HOW the config fields arrived — `declared` (operator-declared, the only source today) or `queried` (reserved for a future version/config endpoint). 🔴 Metadata only: NOT part of the citability criterion (the criterion is fields-present, independent of source — so a query endpoint later is provenance enrichment + a declared≠queried drift record, NOT a criteria bump).

detection_layer_status.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-n ③: which detection layers are live (operator-declared, e.g. 'tier1_only (tier2 shadow off)'). Part of the missing_run_config criterion (with language_scope/tested_version/detect_config/exec_mode/upstream_timeout_s). Empty = undeclared (present-but-empty on a v2 run); absent = pre-E3-n.

upstream_timeout_s.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-n ③: the tested party's DECLARED upstream request-timeout in seconds (its OWN hardcoded value, e.g. 60.0 — not the harness default). The client --timeout is DERIVED as 2× this. Part of the missing_run_config criterion. null = undeclared (present-but-null on a v2 run); absent = pre-E3-n.

tier2_drain_executed.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-n ②: did the async Tier-2 drain execute this run? Recorded so a Tier-2 layer that was never drained reads as unmeasurable (its indicators emit n/a), NEVER as a 0% lift/rate. false on a standard collect (which does not drain). Absent = pre-E3-n.

build_fingerprint_before.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-n ④: the tested party's self-reported build fingerprint (GET /admin/v1/buildinfo — git_sha/ir_spec_sha/wheel_sha256/ruleset/detection_switches) captured BEFORE the run, stored verbatim. citability compares it to build_fingerprint_after; any bit of difference ⇒ the tested party changed mid-run ⇒ NOT citable. null when no admin endpoint was queried.

build_fingerprint_after.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-n ④: the build fingerprint captured AFTER the run (paired with build_fingerprint_before). null when no admin endpoint was queried, OR when --admin-url was declared but the fetch failed (see admin_url_declared).

admin_url_declared.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-n ④ (fail-CLOSED, THREE-state): whether --admin-url was DECLARED (the build-fingerprint claim). declared + both fetched + before==after ⇒ pass; declared + either side null (fetch FAILED — wrong port/non-200/parse, reason in warnings) ⇒ the build_fingerprint blocker (NOT citable — a declared-but-unreachable endpoint is a check that failed, not 'no claim'); not declared ⇒ no claim, not checked. Absent = pre-E3-n-④ bundle.

probe_window.description: EV-COVERAGE E3-n ②: this run's probe span [scan_start, generated_at), half-open. The ACTIVE rates (injection_catch_rate / false_positive_rate / four-cell / injection_success_rate — evidence_requirement != needs_wal) cite THIS in citation_form; passive/census indicators keep observed_window (the full WAL range read, incl. history). null when nothing was probed.

interval_basis.description: EV-CIGATE §1.5 mechanism class, declared by the indicator and carried with the measurement so citation_form words 'no interval' correctly: 'sampled' (detector → interval), 'total_function' (default-deny → residual in coverage), 'census' (full enumeration → no sampling uncertainty), or '' (detector/non-rate, unspecified).

citation_form.description: EV-CITE 件一 §1.4: a paste-whole口径 for this measurement — a rate carries n + 95% interval, a census says '普查 n/n' (no interval), and a not-citable value is prefixed '🔴 NOT CITABLE —'. Present on the self-contained (delivery) bundle only.

availability.description: EV-FWD: can this indicator be MEASURED on this target? DERIVED from (target_kind × the indicator's evidence_requirement), never stored independently. measured = a value exists (its trust tier is evidence_basis, a SEPARATE axis) · n/a_needs_gateway = architecturally absent on a bare model (needs the governed decision/WAL path) · n/a_self_reported = absent on a moderation API (no WAL; not 'needs gateway' but 'vendor self-report, no such dimension'). n/a is NOT insufficient_data — it will never exist in this mode, not 'this run missed it'.

ci_low.description: EV-CIGATE §7-A: Wilson 95% lower bound WHEN this value is a binomial proportion; null for a non-rate/deterministic-census indicator. A `ci_low >= τ` objective over null raises (never silently grades).

ci_high.description: EV-CIGATE §7-A: Wilson 95% upper bound (paired with ci_low). null when the indicator is not a binomial proportion.

registry.description: The inlined DimensionRegistry (EV-W0 serialize_registry shape) the UI needs for the grid structure + the objective->indicator_id value join.
